capabilities.name: AI Provider Abstraction
capabilities.description: Provide one provider interface for local runtimes, user-provided APIs, and later PL-managed hosted AI.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Wave 1.16.1 Provider model capability and routing abstraction
capabilities.notes: Provider identity, availability, streaming, cancellation, capability discovery, errors, and offline state must remain transparent.

capabilities.name: Model Capability Discovery and Routing
capabilities.description: Detect provider and model capabilities, context limits, supported actions, profiles, fallback paths, quotas, and per-task routing.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Wave 1.16.1 Provider model capability and routing abstraction

capabilities.name: Explicit AI Context Selection
capabilities.description: Allow explicit selection of files, ranges, objects, scenes, workflows, projects, and other approved resources used as AI context.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Wave 1.16.2 Context privacy secrets indexing and project memory boundaries
capabilities.notes: Unapproved resources must not be silently included.

capabilities.name: AI Privacy and Secret Boundaries
capabilities.description: Exclude secrets, credentials, ignored files, private paths, and unapproved resources and show what data leaves the device.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Wave 1.16.2 Context privacy secrets indexing and project memory boundaries
capabilities.notes: Local-only operation and no automatic cloud upload are permanent product requirements.

capabilities.name: Local Project AI Memory
capabilities.description: Provide local project indexing and memory with explicit storage, deletion, rebuild, scope, and provider boundaries.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Wave 1.16.2 Context privacy secrets indexing and project memory boundaries

capabilities.name: Structured AI Action Proposals
capabilities.description: Represent AI mutations as reviewed structured actions with affected resources, diffs, previews, validation, risk, and explicit approval.
capabilities.notes: AI mutations may not bypass the normal command and permission systems.

capabilities.name: AI Audit Undo and Recovery
capabilities.description: Record AI requests and actions with provider, context, approvals, affected resources, results, and recovery or undo paths.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Validation and public-beta release gate

capabilities.name: Slice and Workflow AI Assistance
capabilities.description: Provide permissioned assistants for all six slices, Command Center, workflows, terminal, diagnostics, and project-aware operations.
capabilities.notes: AI is optional and must not become a dependency of normal creator workflows.

capabilities.name: AI Evaluation and Disabled-Mode Validation
capabilities.description: Validate privacy, provider routing, action safety, terminal safeguards, quality, failures, and complete operation with AI disabled.
capabilities.source: v1.16 — Validation and public-beta release gate
